Dismissed items
SKUs removed from the active lists today, with justification — restore any time. They come back on their own with the next data update (or tomorrow).
SKUDescriptionReasonNoteDate
Archived work orders
SKUs you archived from Work order coverage with Create Work Order or Covered, or by clicking Create Work Order in the Priority Queue — hidden from those lists and from the Open Sales Orders tab. Restore if you clicked by mistake. Archived items last for the day only: they come back with the next data update (or tomorrow).
SKUDescriptionTypeDate
Open sales orders
Open sales order lines, grouped the way you need (filters, grouping and sort are above) — and whether each item needs a work order. Every filter accepts several choices at once.
A SKU needs a work order when its Available (already net of open orders) plus what is left on its open work order(s) is still negative. Click a work order chip to see each work order's status, schedule and progress. The same item can appear on many orders: its orders, order IDs and P.O.s are listed together and its work order status is shown once for all of them. Click a group header to hide / show what is inside it. Click any grey part of a line to open the incoming-goods dropdown for its SKU (containers already packed, ETA, POs, raw material). To add up quantities, select lines — drag over them, Ctrl+click (⌘ on Mac) to pick one by one, Shift+click for a range — and the totals appear next to the cursor (Esc clears). To resize the grid, drag the edge of a column header (double-click resets that column), drag the bar under the grid to change its height, and use A− / A+ for the text size. By default only what is still to be picked is listed; add Fully Picked in the Picked filter to see those lines too.

Production reports
Every open work order, grouped by where it stands in the production process
A blinking red work order number means it's been open more than 30 days since it was created — hover it to see exactly how long.
Work order coverage
For every SKU that already has an open work order: is what's still left to produce enough to cover the open sales orders?
Balance after WO = Available + quantity left on its work order(s). Available already has open orders subtracted (negative = orders waiting for stock), so orders are not subtracted a second time. This is a quantity check only — it doesn't compare the WO schedule with ship-cancel dates. Create Work Order opens the production system; Covered just archives the SKU. Either way it leaves this list and is kept under Archived for the day — it returns with the next data update.
